    # ==================================================================

    # cycles per well to respect tip capacity.

    # ==================================================================
    # Step 4: Single-channel transfer of reagent A (columns 1-6)
    # ==================================================================
    for col in dest_columns:

            well_name = f"{row}{col}"
            tip = tip_rack[well_name]           # 1:1 tip-to-well mapping
            dest_well = dest_plate[well_name]

            # Fresh tip for each destination well
            await lh.pick_up_tips(tip)

            # Split transfer into 2 x 50 uL aliquots (tip capacity = 50 uL)
            for _ in range(num_aliquots):
                await lh.aspirate(reagent_a, vols=[aliquot_volume])
                await lh.dispense(dest_well, vols=[aliquot_volume])

            # Discard the tip after dispensing
            await lh.drop_tips()
            print(f"Transferred {transfer_volume} uL reagent A -> "

    # ==================================================================
    # Step 5: Summary
    # ==================================================================
    total_wells = len(rows) * len(list(dest_columns))
    print(f"
